column1: # Doctrine-reference integrity manifest (#1465). One repo-relative path per line: every
# file that binding doctrine (a GitHub issue body, #800/#777/#778, or a docs2 handbook)
# cites as authoritative and therefore MUST resolve on a clean checkout. The gate
# (scripts/check-doctrine-refs.ps1) fails if any listed path is not tracked by git, which
# is exactly the failure #1465 caught: fsv.md was cited by #800 but had been silently
# deleted by the 94aa58c8 workspace-sync and lived in only one working tree.
# Add a row whenever new doctrine starts citing a file as binding. Do NOT list files that
# are merely mentioned; list files a clean checkout must contain for doctrine to hold.
